question.text: Will AST publish the practical-driving-test calendar or a candidate convocation for its 73-operator selection by 12 November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves YES if, as of the end of 12 November 2026 (Europe/Rome), AST S.p.A. has published a public item on astsicilia.it — in its "News" or "Lavora con Noi" sections — that states at least one date on which the practical driving tests (prove pratiche di guida) for the selection of 73 operatori di esercizio will be held, whether titled "calendario delle prove pratiche", "convocazione alla prova pratica" or equivalent. A calendar or convocation covering only some venues, cities or batches of candidates counts as YES, and it makes no difference whether the item is the first practical-test calendar published or a revision/update of an earlier one. It resolves NO if no such item has been published by that date. Resolution is based on the "Lavora con Noi" page of astsicilia.it (http://www.astsicilia.it/category/lavora-con-noi) and the notice page it links to, using the publication date displayed there, with the resolver checking on 13 November 2026.
question.fine_print: If astsicilia.it is unreachable or the item is not visible there, the existence and date of the posting may be established via [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions), or via the public notice board of selezioniastpalermo.it if the item appears there but not on astsicilia.it. Items that do not state practical-test dates — for example the outcome of the requirements check, or a list of candidates admitted to or excluded from the practical test — do not count as YES. If AST instead announces the revocation or suspension of this selection on or before 12 November 2026 without having published practical-test dates, the question resolves NO.

research:
Nothing settles this yet. As of 3 November 2026 I found no practical-test calendar or convocation for the 73-driver selection anywhere I could check. AST's own site, astsicilia.it, could not be fetched at all (it returned "self signed certificate" errors), so I could not read the resolution page directly.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-03: Every fetch of astsicilia.it failed with "self signed certificate" (the Lavora con Noi page, the homepage, the RSS feed, the bando PDF and the scores notice). I could not see the latest Lavora con Noi entry myself. The background says it was the scores notice of 26 October 2026.
- 2026-11-03: The application portal selezioniastpalermo.it still shows "NESSUNA SELEZIONE PUBBLICA ATTIVA", has no notices about practical tests, and sends users to astsicilia.it for the calendar and results. [selezioniastpalermo.it](https://selezioniastpalermo.it/)
- 2026-10-26: The scores notice reportedly says the practical-test calendar will be drawn up after the requirements check (art. 8). [AST](http://www.astsicilia.it/elenco-punteggi-prova-preselettiva-selezione-per-lassunzione-di-n-73-operatori-di-esercizio-per-ast-spa/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question either way. Searches found no practical-test calendar or convocation as of 3 November, but I could not check the official page directly.
- There is a new risk to the procedure: a cheating allegation about the pre-selection (see section 3). AST says the selection continues.
- Notice period: Balarm (2 September 2026) summarises the new bando as saying the calendar, venue and times will be published "almeno 15 giorni prima dell'inizio delle prove" (at least 15 days before the tests start). This conflicts with the background's claim that there is no minimum notice. It is also unclear whether the rule covers the practical test or only the start of testing. [Balarm](https://www.balarm.it/news/l-ast-torna-ad-assumere-in-sicilia-a-tempo-indeterminato-requisiti-e-come-candidarsi-169282)
  - If it does cover the practical test, tests held in late November would need a calendar posted around 12 to 15 November.
  - The pre-selection fits the rule: its calendar was posted around 5 October for tests on 21 October, about 16 days ahead.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-31: Tempostretto: Genovese has started an internal inspection. If irregularities emerge, AST will file a complaint with prosecutors and then decide whether the competition continues. For now, "Concorso va avanti" (the competition goes ahead). [Tempostretto](https://www.tempostretto.it/news/candidato-usa-ia-alla-selezione-ast-genovese-concorso-va-avanti.html)
- 2026-10-30: Giornale di Sicilia: regional deputy Pippo Lombardo published chat screenshots allegedly showing a candidate using AI to get correct quiz answers during the exam. Authenticity is not yet verified. Lombardo announced a parliamentary question and asked to see the documents.
  - AST president Luigi Genovese asked the external exam company for a report. He said the competition will not be suspended for now.
  - Genovese said AST risks halting buses if the 73 new drivers are not in service by the end of the month, which I read as end of November. [GdS](https://gds.it/articoli/cronaca/2026/10/30/concorso-ast-un-candidato-usa-lintelligenza-artificiale-durante-lesame-e-pubblica-gli-screen-in-una-chat-072ef737-a3ad-45ab-bebd-a1cee3f77dc2/)
- 2026-10-30: LiveSicilia: Lombardo asked that all documentation be preserved and that AST reply before any final decision on the selection results. [LiveSicilia](https://livesicilia.it/concorso-ast-73-operatori-lombardo-verifiche-prova-scritta/)
- Unverified: one search summary said the Sicilian regional assembly (ARS) authorised extending the current temporary drivers' contracts only to 15 November. I could not confirm this in any article.
- Earlier in 2026: the first bando was revoked by AST's board after pressure from an ARS committee and unions backing the temporary drivers. [La Sicilia](https://www.lasicilia.it/news/cronaca/3020115/assunzioni-ast-retromarcia-a-sorpresa-il-cda-revoca-il-bando-per-73-autisti-dentro-la-crisi-di-conti-e-di-consenso-che-ha-cambiato-la-rotta.html)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-21: AST posted the pre-selection calendar about 16 days before the tests and updated it on 12 October. [AST](http://www.astsicilia.it/selezione-per-assunzione-di-n73-operatori-di-esercizio-per-ast-s-p-a-nei-giorni-del-21-22-23-ottobre-2026/)
- 2026-10-23/26: Scores came out within 0 to 3 days of the sessions.
- AMAT Palermo, another Sicilian bus operator, published a driving-test calendar on 27 October for tests on 3 to 6 November (from the background, not checked by me). In an earlier round it published one calendar covering tests from 31 August to 4 December. [La Sicilia](https://www.lasicilia.it/news/cronaca/3063833/il-concorso-amat-per-50-autisti-riaperto-ecco-le-date-per-i-test-di-guida-prove-dal-31-agosto-al-4-dicembre.html)
- AST already revoked one version of this selection in 2026 under political pressure, so a suspension or revocation is a plausible risk.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction market or expert forecast on this question. The Kalshi and Polymarket prices collected by code are unrelated (for example, the "AST" market is about AST SpaceMobile).

## 6. Upcoming events before 12 November
- The external exam company's report and AST's internal inspection on the AI allegation. A complaint to prosecutors or a suspension would push toward NO.
- AST's possible reply to Lombardo's document request and his parliamentary question.
- The requirements check, which must finish before the calendar is drawn up. No completion date is known.
- Possibly 15 November: reported (unconfirmed) expiry of the temporary drivers' contracts. Together with the "end of month" service target, this puts pressure on AST to publish quickly.
- The resolver checks on 13 November.

- **Notice period, conflicting sources:** Some search summaries say dates will be posted "almeno 15 giorni prima dell'inizio delle prove" (at least 15 days before the tests start). These seem to come from articles on the January bando (for example Lentepubblica, February 2026), which also describes a 50-point, 20 km test, unlike the August bando's 40-point, 15 km test. LiveSicilia's article on the August bando mentions no notice period. Even if a 15-day rule applies, it only fixes how far ahead the calendar must appear, not when AST has to post it. [Lentepubblica](https://lentepubblica.it/cittadini-e-imprese/ast-sicilia-assume-concorso-per-73-posti-fissi-per-autisti-ecco-come-candidarsi/)

## 4. Base rates
- Inside this procedure, from the question background and the AST page:
  - The pre-selection calendar went up about 5 to 12 October, roughly one to two weeks before the 21-23 October sessions. [AST notice](http://www.astsicilia.it/selezione-per-assunzione-di-n73-operatori-di-esercizio-per-ast-s-p-a-nei-giorni-del-21-22-23-ottobre-2026/)
  - Scores were published within one to three days of the sessions.
- The question background says AMAT Palermo posted a calendar on 27 October for driving tests on 3-6 November. I did not verify this independently.
- I found no record of how long AST's requirement checks have taken in past selections.

## 5. Other forecasts
- None of the collected Kalshi or Polymarket markets match this question. "AST" there refers to AST SpaceMobile, which is unrelated. I found no expert or market forecast.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- **15 November 2026:** The agency-staff contracts expire, three days after the question's deadline. This puts strong pressure on AST either to schedule the driving tests quickly or to seek another extension.
- AST still has to finish the requirements check that the 26 October notice says must come before the calendar.
- Possible political moves (Ars or the Regione extending the agency contracts or legislating to make them permanent) could reduce the urgency. I found no reporting of such a move yet.
- The resolver checks on 13 November, using the publication date shown on astsicilia.it.

**Gaps:** I could not access astsicilia.it at all because of the certificate error, and I found no news from October or November 2026 about the practical-test timing.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 10 days remain (3 to 12 November 2026); the resolver checks on 13 November. For YES, AST must post on astsicilia.it ("News" or "Lavora con Noi") an item giving at least one date for the practical driving tests of the 73-operator selection. A partial or batch calendar counts.

(b) Status quo: nothing posted. The latest item is the 26 October scores notice, and a requirements check must finish before the calendar is drawn up. If nothing changes, the answer is NO.

(c) Base rate: Italian public-company hiring procedures that say the "next step comes after the requirements check" rarely publish the next calendar within about 2.5 weeks of the scores. They more often take 3 to 6 weeks. AST itself was quick, though: about 8 days from application close to the pre-selection calendar, and 0 to 3 days from tests to scores. For a roughly two-week window from the scores, I put the reference rate at about 30-40%.

(d) Evidence for YES:
- On 30 October AST's president Genovese said AST risks halting buses unless the 73 drivers are in service by the end of the month, which I read as end of November.
- The temporary drivers' contracts may expire on 15 November (unconfirmed).
- If the bando requires 15 days' notice, practical tests in late November require a calendar around 9 to 15 November.
- AST's demonstrated speed in October.

Evidence for NO:
- The requirements check covers hundreds of candidates, and commissions and dual-control buses must be organised in about six cities.
- The AI-cheating allegation (30 to 31 October) led to an internal inspection, a parliamentary question, and a request that documents be preserved before any decision. This invites caution.
- AST already revoked this selection once in 2026 under political pressure.
- Nothing was found as of 3 November.

(e) NO scenario: the requirements check and the inspection of the cheating claim drag into mid-November, and the calendar appears around 18 to 25 November for December tests.
YES scenario: under service pressure, AST finishes checking the top-ranked candidates by about 10 November and posts a first-batch Palermo/Catania calendar for tests starting about 25 November.

(f) I start at about 35%. The urgency, combined with a possible 15-day notice rule, pushes up a little. The cheating controversy and the political scrutiny push down. These roughly offset, and I end at about 37%.

Probability: 37%

(b) If nothing changes, the outcome is NO. As of 26 October to 3 November no calendar has been published, and the requirements check (art. 8) has to finish first.

(c) The reference class is Italian public transport companies moving from published pre-selection scores to a practical-test calendar. Delays of several weeks to months are common. AST itself has been unusually fast this round: the pre-selection calendar went up about 16 days ahead of the sessions, and scores came out within 0 to 3 days of them. Getting from scores (26 October) to a calendar by 12 November means doing it within about 17 days. My base rate for that, across similar regional selections, is roughly 30-35%.

(d) Evidence for YES:

YES scenario: the inspection finds nothing serious, and the requirements check wraps up in the first week of November. Under service pressure, AST posts a calendar around 7 to 12 November for tests starting in late November.

(f) I start from about 33%. I move up for the strong operational pressure, AST's demonstrated speed and the 15-day notice arithmetic, which pushes posting toward this window. I move down for the cheating controversy and the political scrutiny. The net result is slightly above the base rate.
